description: He wears a muted dark-red knee-length wool-like tunic with narrow gold woven borders at the neckline, sleeve cuffs, front and hem. A cream underlayer shows at neck and wrists. A short burgundy-brown shoulder mantle has a decorated gold border and is fastened by a round gold-toned brooch with a slender connecting clasp. A brown leather-looking belt has circular metal fittings, a buckle and a long decorated strap. Fitted brown legwear and tall brown boots complete the substantial opaque outfit. Exact fiber composition is uncertain; there is no headgear or weapon.
